0.reason: recovery_liveness.py owns the manifest-versus-attempt comparison the review directed the fix through; the path is accepted at promotion with --accept-path

findings.text: the manifest-vs-attempt owner was extended in a file outside the node's declared write paths (plan section 34 and prompt.txt:69-72 grant only recovery_classification.py, the test and the evidence anchors), so the node's landing needs the coordinator to widen section 34's write paths or revert the hunk, as the manifest's follow_ons already states.

test_a_run_with_no_recorded_attempt_start_reads_as_today does not isolate its claimed condition: _write_run (:175) always writes a worker record dated 30 s before now, so the run does have an attempt clock and the assertion at :294 passes because the manifest is newer than that launch, not because no clock exists; the "no recorded attempt start reads as today" clause is therefore not causally covered.
the guard docstring states it "adds the two facts a state reading needs" but then enumerates three facts at :50, :57 and :62, so the count contradicts the text below it.
the reasoning that the pointer's liveness belongs to the replaced attempt is written twice near-verbatim (:297-303 and :314-322), so a reader meets one fact stated as if it were two.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against base 050a6556c; 49dae5a6e adds the guard (line 26) and the manifest-clearing stanza (line 291), 6e08e1332 defers to the exit record, fc3b1a332 extracts _manifest_predates_the_current_attempt / _manifest_written_before / _worker_launch_seconds into recovery_liveness.py:254-316 and makes _worker_launched_after_manifest delegate, and 54435b9d5 restates the rule's facts in the guard docstring; the fragment is a 3-line evidence anchor.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when names three readings and a base/head gate over the importing test files; tests/test_a_resumed_run_is_not_read_by_its_old_status.py:251/274/294 assert the blocked-predating->working, blocked-rewritten->blocked and no-clock->as-today readings, and the manifest records base 1 failed/456 passed and head 1 failed/464 passed with the same single failure id; the in-progress word is deliberately left alone (:337), so "every non-terminal word the reset leaves" is asserted for blocked and waiting only.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is that a run whose manifest predates its current attempt is read by that attempt's liveness, not the old status word; reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:26 defines _manifest_is_the_predecessor_attempts_report and :291 applies it, clearing the manifest word, liveness and wait declaration so a resumed run is read from its own attempt.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it reads status complete, names commits 49dae5a6e, 6e08e1332, fc3b1a332 and 54435b9d5, records the base arm at 1 failed/456 passed and the head arm at 1 failed/464 passed with the same single failure, the negative control at 5 failed/3 passed, and points at gate-base.log, gate-head.log and negative-control.log; follow_ons names the recovery_liveness.py scope extension.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read from the dispatch fence (prompt.txt:69-72): declared paths are reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py, tests/test_a_resumed_run_is_not_read_by_its_old_status.py, the evidence fragment and the figure directory; the diff touches all but the figure directory, and additionally reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py, which is outside the grant.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_resumed_run_is_not_read_by_its_old_status.py:251 compares the classifier's output to the literal "running" and negative-control.log shows the first case red when the guard is disabled, but the no-clock clause at :294 is not isolated.
justifications.evidence: the manifest records the two gate logs' own summary lines (base "1 failed, 456 passed", head "1 failed, 464 passed") with a zero added-failure delta, and negative-control.log's last line ("5 failed, 3 passed") shows five failures the head arm does not carry.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:47 says "the two facts" then enumerates three, and the pointer-liveness reasoning is written twice near-verbatim at :297 and :314.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:291 clears the predating manifest's word, so the blocked fixture at tests/test_a_resumed_run_is_not_read_by_its_old_status.py:251 reads running rather than its predecessor's blocked.
justifications.reuse: the fork the prior review found is resolved: _manifest_written_before and _manifest_predates_the_current_attempt now live in the owner reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py:266/281 and _worker_launched_after_manifest:302 delegates to them, so one owner answers the question.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff edits reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py, which is outside the write paths declared at prompt.txt:69-72 and in plan section 34.
